title: Dispatch FLE 3: A Coffin Is Buried under the Wrong Name
summary: The living Dr. Voss watches without claiming its occupant.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: The service proceeded after an unopened coffin arrived with the undertaker’s seal. Dr. Voss stood beside the mourners. She recognized several who greeted her as a stranger, including a woman who called herself her daughter.

Inspector Daniel Voss, the explorer’s brother, requested that the burial be delayed. The family named in the other account insisted the deceased had earned her rest. A magistrate allowed the service but ordered the grave watched until the identity dispute could be examined.
